d:
Gokuldham society prepares for Mahashivratri pooja. Popatlal, eager to reach the Shiv temple on time for his marriage prayers, wakes up early at 4:30 AM and loudly rouses everyone in the society, annoying the residents before he falls asleep on a bench downstairs.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
